explanation: The top-level corpus contains eight qualifying demand records because every record n06-r01 through n06-r08 has demand_score >= 3. Job 1 should therefore preserve all qualifying records for both downstream handoffs. Instead, the observed Job-2 input contains only n06-r02 through n06-r08, with n06-r01 omitted. The supplied Job-1 normalize function explains the omission: its allowed_record_ids list includes n06-r09 but excludes n06-r01, so it filters out the highest-demand stipulated record before producing the needs and evidence_sources handoffs. Job 2 appears to preserve and rank the records it actually received, so the supported fault localizes upstream to normalize.
